Menu.Name: Backup & Restore
Menu.Label: Open Backup & Restore
Menu.Hint: Back up or restore the Shared Data compendiums manually and compare what is in the world with what is in the backup.

AutoBackup.Name: Automatic backup
AutoBackup.Hint: Save a copy of every Shared Data compendium outside the module folder whenever its contents change, and when the world loads. This lets you update the module without losing your custom content.

AutoRestore.Name: Automatic restore
AutoRestore.Hint: When the world loads, refill any Shared Data compendium that is empty (for example after a module update) from its backup. Compendiums that already contain entries are never touched.

BackupFolder.Name: Backup folder
BackupFolder.Hint: Folder inside your Foundry user Data directory where backups are stored. It must NOT be inside the module folder. Use the same folder in every world so they all share one backup.

Menu.Title: Shared Data: Backup & Restore
Menu.Intro: Every Shared Data compendium is copied to the backup folder below. After a module update, empty compendiums are refilled from this copy automatically.
Menu.Footnote: Rows in orange have more entries in the backup than in the module. "Restore missing entries" adds them back without changing or deleting anything already in the compendiums.
Menu.RestoreConfirm: Add every entry from the backup that is missing from the Shared Data compendiums? Existing entries are not changed or deleted.

Notify.BackupDone: Shared Data: backed up {packs} compendiums ({docs} entries) to Data/{path}.
Notify.BackupErrors: Shared Data: backup failed for {packs}. See the browser console (F12) for details.
Notify.RestoreDone: Shared Data: restored {docs} entries into {packs} compendiums from backup ({assets} asset files).
Notify.RestoreNothing: Shared Data: nothing to restore, every backed-up entry is already in the compendiums.
Notify.RestoreErrors: Shared Data: restore failed for {packs}. Your backup was not changed. See the browser console (F12) for details.
Notify.BadFolder: Shared Data: the backup folder is inside the module folder and would be wiped by updates. Choose another folder in Game Settings.
Notify.StartupError: Shared Data: automatic backup/restore failed. See the browser console (F12) for details.
